summary: Implementation plan for upgrading the Residential 2BHK Interior Twin — 3D CAD Model with First-Person POV Walkthrough (WASD + Room Waypoints), Interactive 3D Exploded Distribution Board (TPN DB with clickable MCBs, RCCBs, and Copper Busbars), Multi-Layer Visibility Toggles, and real GLB/glTF 3D & DXF 2D CAD exports.
